correctness.rationale: For a constant \(p^*\), the model right-hand side vanishes by definition. Applying the source inverse identity to a zero generalized derivative gives \(p^*(\omega(t)-\omega(0))/\omega(t)=0\). Positivity of \(\omega\) and \(p^*\ne0\) force \(\omega(t)=\omega(0)\) for every \(t\). The exact baseline parameters give \(\lambda=-1\), \(\delta=5\), \(p^*=5\), while \(\omega(t)=1+t\) gives weighted increment \(5/2\) at \(t=1\), directly contradicting zero.
